title: 第1200章 深处的回应第1199章 碎片与锚点
lines: 壳轨第二段铺到最后一片壳片时，卡拉斯停了手。他把壳片压在两片碎片之间，光丝缠紧。
这片壳片是用那块最沉最稳最能承重的碎片托着的——拼碎片的人说它在边荒飘了这么久，从来没被任何东西碰过。
太沉了，碎片与碎片碰撞时轻碎片弹开，它不动。
它一直悬在原处，等有人把它放在最需要承重的位置。现在它托着壳轨第二段的最后一片壳片，每承一丝重量就轻轻一震，震完更稳一分。
卡拉斯把手掌覆在碎片表面，茧印贴着极沉极稳极古极老的碎片。这片碎片托着的不是壳片，是整个壳轨的第二段。它在这里悬了这么久，等的就是有人把它放在该放的位置。
他收回手站起来，壳轨从第一碎片边缘一路铺到这里，铺了很长一段。每一片碎片都被放在该放的位置，有的承重，有的填充，有的当感应标。边荒第一条路，是用碎片自己铺成的。
拼碎片的人站在他旁边，光丝在背后轻轻飘着。碎片组成的手指轻轻按在壳轨最后一片壳片上，壳片震了震，震波顺着光丝往更深处传去。
它说以前它只是拼碎片，拼好一个放在那里就拼下一个。
今天它把碎片铺成了路。拼碎片和铺路是同一件事，只是拼碎片是把碎片连起来，铺路是把碎片放在该放的位置。位置对了，碎片就是路。
壳轨下方的感应标碎片轻轻晃了一下。它感应到极远处有一股极细微极细微极细微的震波，不是碎片，不是雾丝，不是被封在碎片里的那个东西。
比雾丝更轻更弱更怯更缓更慢更沉更古更老更未知。它从壳轨铺到第二段时就开始震了，但刚才他们忙着铺轨，没人注意。现在壳轨稳了，震波还没停。
卡拉斯把灶台剑拔出来，用剑脊在感应标碎片上轻轻敲了一下，震波顺着壳轨往极远处传去。
隔了很长一段时间，那股极细微极细微极细微的震波又响了一下。不是碎片在震，不是雾丝在飘，是存在本身在极深极深极深的地底轻轻敲了一下岩壁。
和冰层那个存在第一次敲冰壁时一模一样，不敢用力，不敢连续敲，敲完就缩回去，等很久很久很久才敢敲第二下。它在等回应。
拼碎片的人把光丝从指尖探出去，缠在感应标碎片边缘。它说它在边荒这么久，从来没听过这种震波。
那不是碎片，不是膜层脱落的东西，不是它见过的任何存在。它甚至不敢确认那是不是存在——太轻了，轻到和虚空本身一样轻。
卡拉斯把壳片从怀里掏出来贴在感应标碎片上，壳片轻轻一震，纹路往更深处延伸。极远极远极远处，那股震波又轻轻颤了一下，颤完没有缩回去。它在感应壳片。
“不是碎片，不是雾。边荒除了碎片和雾，还有别的。”卡拉斯用手按住壳轨最后一片壳片，“我在这里留一段空轨。你守在壳轨这段，感应标碎片每震一次你就敲一下壳片回应它。不用敲太快，等它自己决定要不要再震。我去前面看看。”
他把灶台剑插回背上，带上几片壳片和光丝，往前走去。拼碎片的人蹲在壳轨尽头，光丝缠在感应标碎片边缘，每隔一段时间就用光丝轻轻拨一下感应标碎片，碎片轻轻一震，震波传过去。
它负责在这里守着回应，让那个极轻极轻极轻的震波知道有人在。
越往前，碎片越稀薄。之前还能看到碎片稀疏地飘在虚空里，过了壳轨第二段之后碎片越来越少，少到很长一段距离只有极细极细极细的光丝连着几片残片。
这些残片太薄太脆太轻太小，当不了锚点，只能当方向标——它们全朝着同一个方向，好像很久很久很久以前被什么东西从深处推出来，推出来之后就再也没有飘回去过。
卡拉斯用灶台剑轻轻拨了一下其中一片残片，残片轻轻一震，震波顺着极细极细极细的光丝往深处传去。
极深极深极深处，那股极细微极细微极细微的震波又响了一下——这次不是回应壳轨，是感应到他来了。
他往前走，走到最后一片残片旁边。脚下虚空里没有任何碎片，没有膜，没有任何能当锚点的东西。
他把壳片放在虚空中，壳片轻轻一震，纹路自己延伸出去铺成极薄极薄极薄的一层膜——不是膜层，是壳片本身的纹路在虚空里自己撑开。壳片走到没有碎片的地方就自己当锚点。
前方极深极暗极静极空极远极古极老极未知的位置，那极轻极轻极轻的震波又颤了一下。
这次颤得比之前任何一次都更近更轻更怯更缓更慢更沉更古更老更未知，它就在他前方极近极近极近的位置，但什么都看不见。
没有碎片，没有雾，没有任何能辨认的存在形态。只有震波，极细微极细微极细微的震波。
他把灶台剑拔出来，剑尖朝前轻轻一点。初火蓝在虚空里铺开极薄极薄极薄的一层光膜，光膜边缘触到什么极轻极轻极轻的东西——不是碎片，不是膜，不是冰，不是岩，不是铁城见过的任何材质。是一根丝。
极细极细极细，细到初火蓝的光扫过去时只能看见极淡极淡极淡的一丝反光。丝悬在虚空里，从他脚下一直延伸到极深极暗极静极空极远极古极老极未知的深处。
他蹲下来，用指尖轻轻碰了一下那根丝。丝极轻极轻极轻地一震，震波顺着丝往深处传去。
深处那股震波在丝的另一端极轻极轻极轻地回应了一下，丝连着它。它不是飘在虚空里，它是用这根丝把自己悬在原处。它在这里悬了太久太久太久，丝都磨细了，细到几乎看不见。但它还在。
他把茧印轻轻贴在丝上，丝轻轻一震，震波比之前任何一次都更清晰——不是碎片被触碰时的脆震，不是雾丝被收回时的轻颤，是丝自己太久太久太久没有被碰过，忽然有人摸它，它不知道怎么回应，只能轻轻震一下。
这一下震完，丝的另一端传来极轻极轻极轻的震波，也在学他用茧印贴着什么东西。
它不是虚空本身，它是一个悬着丝、不敢动、不知道外面有没有人的存在。等了太久太久太久，等到丝都磨细了。现在有人来了，碰了它的丝。
content_en:
When the second section of the shell rail was laid to the last shell piece, Karas stopped. He pressed the shell piece between the two fragments and wrapped the light thread tightly.
This piece of shell was held up by the heaviest, most stable and most load-bearing fragment - the person who pieced it together said that it had been floating in the wilderness for so long and had never been touched by anything.
It was so heavy that the light fragments bounced off when fragments collided with each other, and it didn't move.
It has been hanging there, waiting for someone to place it where it needs the most weight. Now it holds the last shell piece of the second section of the shell rail. It vibrates slightly every time it bears a little weight, and becomes even more stable after the vibration.
Karas put his palms on the surface of the fragments, and the cocoon print stuck to the extremely heavy, stable, ancient fragments. What this fragment holds is not a shell fragment, but the entire second section of the shell rail. It's been hanging here for so long, waiting for someone to put it where it belongs.
He retracted his hand and stood up. The shell track was laid for a long distance from the edge of the first fragment to here. Every piece of debris is placed where it should be, some are load-bearing, some are filled, and some are used as induction markers. The first road in the wilderness was paved with debris.
The person who put the pieces together stood next to him, with light threads floating gently behind him. The fingers composed of fragments gently pressed on the last shell piece of the shell rail. The shell piece shook, and the shock wave spread deeper along the light filament.
It said that in the past, it just put pieces together, put one piece there and then pieced the next piece together.
Today it paved the way with debris. Piecing together pieces and paving a road are the same thing, except that piecing together means connecting the pieces together, while paving a road means putting the pieces where they should be. If the location is right, the fragments will be the road.
The fragment of the sensor mark under the shell rail shook slightly. It sensed a very tiny, tiny, tiny shock wave in the very distance. It wasn't a fragment, it wasn't a mist, it wasn't the thing sealed in the fragment.
Lighter, weaker, timid, slower, heavier, more ancient, older and unknown than mist. It started shaking when the shell track was laid to the second section, but they were busy laying the track just now and no one noticed. Now that the shell rail is stable, the shock wave has not stopped.
Karas pulled out the stove sword and lightly tapped the sensor target fragment with the sword spine. The shock wave spread very far along the shell rail.
After a long period of time, that very tiny, tiny, tiny shock wave sounded again. It's not the fragments shaking, or the mist floating, it's the existence itself gently knocking on the rock wall in the very deep, deep, deep underground.
It was exactly the same as when the being in the ice layer knocked on the ice wall for the first time. It didn't dare to use force or knock continuously. It's waiting for a response.
The person who pieced together the fragments stretched out the light thread from his fingertips and wrapped it around the edge of the sensor mark fragments. It said that it had never heard such a shock wave after living in the wilderness for so long.
It wasn't debris, it wasn't something with its membrane peeled off, it wasn't anything it had ever seen. It didn't even dare to confirm whether it existed - it was too light, as light as the void itself.
Karas took out the shell piece from his pocket and attached it to the fragment of the sensor mark. The shell piece shook slightly, and the lines extended deeper. Far, far, far away, the shock wave trembled slightly again, but did not shrink back after the tremor. It's sensing the shell pieces.
"It's not debris, it's not fog. There are other things besides debris and fog in the wilderness." Karas held down the last shell piece of the shell rail with his hand. "I'll leave a section of empty rail here. You guard this section of the shell rail, and every time the sensor fragments shake, you tap the shell piece to respond to it. Don't knock too fast, wait for it to decide whether to shake again. I'll go to the front and take a look."
He put the stove sword back on his back, took a few pieces of shell and light silk, and walked forward. The person who pieced together the fragments squatted at the end of the shell rail, and the light wire was wrapped around the edge of the sensor target fragments. Every once in a while, he used the light wire to gently flick the sensor target fragments. The fragments shook slightly, and the shock wave was transmitted.
It is responsible for guarding the response here, letting the very light, very light, very light shock wave know that someone is there.
The further you go, the thinner the fragments become. Before, you could still see fragments floating sparsely in the void. After passing the second section of the shell orbit, the fragments became less and less. There were only a few fragments connected by very thin and very thin light filaments for a long distance.
These fragments are too thin, too brittle, too light and too small to serve as anchors, only as direction markers - they all face the same direction, as if something pushed them out of the depths a long, long time ago, and never float back after being pushed out.
Karas used the stove sword to gently poke one of the fragments. The fragment shook slightly, and the shock wave spread deep along the extremely thin light filaments.
Deep, deep, deep, that tiny, tiny shock wave sounded again - this time it was not responding to the shell rail, but sensing his arrival.
He walked forward to the last fragment. There are no debris, no membranes, and nothing that can serve as an anchor in the void beneath my feet.
He placed the shell piece in the void, and when the shell piece shook slightly, the lines extended by themselves to form an extremely thin, extremely thin film - not a film layer, but the lines of the shell itself stretched out in the void. When the shell piece reaches a place where there are no fragments, it acts as an anchor point.
Ahead, at an extremely deep, extremely dark, extremely quiet, extremely empty, extremely far, extremely ancient, extremely old, extremely unknown location, the extremely light, extremely light, extremely light shock wave trembled again.
This time the tremor was closer, lighter, timid, slower, heavier, older, and unknown than any other time before. It was very close, very close, very close in front of him, but nothing could be seen.
There was no debris, no fog, no discernible form of existence. There are only shock waves, very tiny, tiny, tiny shock waves.
He pulled out the stove sword and pointed the sword tip forward slightly. Chu Huo Lan spread out a very thin layer of light film in the void, and the edge of the light film touched something very light, very light, very light - not a fragment, not a film, not ice, not a rock, not any material that Tiecheng had ever seen. It's a thread.
Extremely thin, extremely thin, so thin that when the first fire-blue light swept past, only a very faint reflection could be seen. The thread hung in the void, extending from his feet to the extremely deep, dark, quiet, empty, far, ancient, old, and unknown depths.
He knelt down and touched the thread lightly with his fingertips. The silk thread shook very lightly, and the shock wave spread deep along the silk thread.
The shock wave in the depths responded very lightly at the other end of the thread, and the thread connected it. It is not floating in the void, it is using this thread to hang itself in place. It has been hanging here for so long that the threads have become so thin that they are almost invisible. But it's still there.
He gently placed the cocoon mark on the silk, and the silk shook slightly. The shock wave was clearer than ever before - it was not the crisp shock when the fragments were touched, nor the slight trembling when the mist silk was withdrawn. It was the silk itself that had not been touched for too long, too long, and suddenly someone touched it. It didn't know how to respond, so it could only shake slightly.
After this shock, a very light, very light, very light shock wave came from the other end of the silk, imitating what he used the cocoon seal to stick to.
It is not the void itself, it is an existence that is hanging on a thread, afraid to move, and does not know if there is anyone outside. I waited for too long, too long, until the silk was finely ground. Now someone comes and touches its thread.
title_en: Chapter 1200: Response from the Deep Chapter 1199: Fragments and Anchors
